result.topic_en: Bare calculations with second-order differential operators in two variables r and s, with coefficients a, b, c, and conditions on their partial derivatives (apparently reducing a quadratic form/operator to a normal form, related to the heat-conduction prize problem).
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}+b-2\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}-\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r}\right)^2=0$
$\partial_r^2+a\partial_r\partial_s+b\partial_s^2=0$ [?]
$b\partial_s^2+c\partial_s\partial_r+\partial_r\partial_s$ [-...-] $\partial_t$ [?]
$2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}=-\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}-\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}\;-a\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}+2b\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}-6a\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial r^2}-4\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial r}$ [?]
$+2a\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial r^2}-2a\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}-4\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\right)^2-2a\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}$ [?]
[-...-]
$-b\partial_s\partial_r^2(\partial_r^2+a\partial_r+b\partial_s)$ [?]
$-c\partial_s\partial_r(\partial_r^2+a\partial_r+b\partial_s)$ [?]
$\partial_r^2\partial_s^2+ab\partial_r^2\partial_s+b\partial_s^3+c\partial_s^2\partial_r+ac\partial_r^2\partial_s+c\partial_r\partial_s^2$ [?]
$+2\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\partial_r\partial_s+a\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\partial_s+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}\partial_s^2+2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_r\partial_s+a\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_s-\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}\partial_r\partial_s$ [?]
$+\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\partial_s^2\qquad+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}\partial_s$ [?]
$-b\partial_s^2\partial_r^2-ba\partial_s^2\partial_r-b\partial_s^3-c\partial_s^2\partial_r-ac\partial_r\partial_s-c\partial_r\partial_s^2$ [?]
$-2b\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_s\partial_r\qquad-c\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_s$ [?]
$-b\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}\partial_r\qquad-c\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_r^3$ [?]
$-c\frac{\partial a}{\partial r\partial s}\partial_r^2$ [?]
$-2\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_r\qquad+2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_r\partial_s+c\partial_r^2\partial_s\qquad 2\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}=0\qquad 6=-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}-c\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}-2a\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\qquad c=\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}$ [?]
$-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}\partial_r\qquad+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}\partial_r\partial_s+2c\qquad a=2\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}$ [?]
$+\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}\partial_r\partial_s\qquad 2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}=0\qquad \frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial r^2}\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s^2}+a\gamma=0\qquad \frac{\partial a}{\partial s}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}=0\qquad 2b+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial s\partial r}+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}$ [?]
$+a\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_r\partial_s\qquad \frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial r^2}+c\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial r^2}+b\gamma=0\qquad 2\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}=0$ [?]
$-c\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\partial_r\partial_s\qquad \partial_r^2+c\partial_r+b\qquad \frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial r\partial s}+a\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial s}-c\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\gamma$ [?]
$\partial_r^2+\partial_s+a$
$-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}+2\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r\partial s}\partial_r-c\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}+2\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\partial_r\qquad \frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s\partial r}+\left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}+b\right)\gamma$ [?]
$\partial_r^2+b\partial_s+c\partial_r\qquad -\frac{\partial a}{\partial s^2}\qquad+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}\partial_r\qquad+\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s\partial r}$ [?]
$\partial_r^2+b\partial_s+a\partial_r\qquad +\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}\partial_r\qquad+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}\qquad-c\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial r}+\left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}-ac\right)\gamma$ [?]
$-2\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_r\partial_s+2\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\partial_r\partial_s\qquad+2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_r^2-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}\partial_r^2\qquad -2a\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\qquad \frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s^2}+\frac{-2\partial c}{\partial s}\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial r}+\left(\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}\right)\gamma$ [?]
$+\left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}+b\right)\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial s}-\left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}+b\right)\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial r}$ [?]
$-2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}\partial_r$ [-...-] $+\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_r+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}\partial_r+\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}\partial_r+\left(a\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}-\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\right)\partial_r-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}c\partial_r\qquad-\left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}-ac\right)\gamma$ [?]
$+\frac{\partial^2 b}{\partial r^2}\partial_s+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}\partial_s+a\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\partial_s-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_s\qquad b=\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial s\partial r}+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}$ [?]
$2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}=\partial_r\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}+b+\tfrac12 aa\right)\qquad c=-2\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}\qquad-\left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\right)\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial r}$ [?]
[-...-] $\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}$ [?]
[-$\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\;\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\;(\partial\alpha)^2=2\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}$-] [?]
$a\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\;b\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}$ [?]
$a=\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r^2}\qquad-\left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial r^2}-\frac{\partial ac}{\partial r}\right)\gamma$ [?]
$\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}$
$c=\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}\qquad \partial_s^2+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial s\partial r}+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}$ [?]
$\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}=\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}+\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial s}+\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r}\right)^2\qquad \partial_r\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}-\tfrac12 b^2+\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}+ac\right)=\partial_s\left(2\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}-c\right)\qquad \partial_r^2+\partial_s+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}$ [?]
$-\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial s^2}=-\frac{\partial^3\alpha}{\partial r^2\partial s}-2\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial s}\right)^2+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}-2\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r}\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}$ [?]
$=\frac{\partial^3\alpha}{\partial r^2\partial s}-\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}+\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r}\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r\partial s}$ [?]

methods.what: Commutator/composition of second-order differential operators in r,s expanded term by term
Expressing coefficients through second derivatives of a potential alpha
Second-order PDE system for an auxiliary function gamma
